archives.description: A broadsheet magazine — 'The Dispatch'. Stacked newspaper masthead with a Fraunces nameplate, a cover-story lead in high-contrast display serif, a full-width pull-quote band over a generative topographic-contour engraving, an asymmetric features well, and a department-grouped table of contents. Lora serif reading column with drop caps, folios, and double rules on warm ivory newsprint with a single claret accent.

Strict 12-column grid, neo-grotesque Inter set flush-left ragged-right, hairline rules, zero radius, and a single signal-red accent on warm off-white. Signature numbered editorial index plus a generative Müller-Brockmann grid composition.
Dark terminal aesthetic with cyan accents, monospace git-log timeline, WebGL mountains, and dual tech/trek theming
